policy: Source authoritative. A naming match is not semantic proof. No entry is verified without differential test and formal evidence; compiler success is insufficient.

mappings.notes: Box now owns original SetParent, AddChildren, RemoveChildren, AddBall, AddStaticCollidable, RemoveBall, RemoveStaticCollidable, ReleaseBox, SetObject, Traverse and NearbyBubbles algorithms or entrypoints. Bevy Partition remains authoritative index; full equivalence not established.

Partitionable fields now use the exact C++ names mId, mHandled, mNewPos, mOldPos, mNewBubble, mOldBubble, isInteractive, mBoxes, mMyBox, mPark, mEffectStamp, isMoribund. Virtual behavior remains in a separate trait; formal/behavioral parity is unproven.
Canonical Key now declared in partition.rs with C++-named Clamp and original branch ordering; KeyHash and proof remain unimplemented.
Ported C++ hash-combine expression under wrapping size_t arithmetic with GCC std::hash<int64_t> identity; operator() syntax has no stable Rust equivalent and global equivalence is unproven.
Resource semantics and method ownership differ; BoxAllocator and full Ball integration absent.

All five configuration fields now retain their exact C++ m_* names and Blue metadata keeps original Python property names; process-global original settings versus per-Bevy-World staged resource still differs.
CGP providers, bridge and deferred updates introduce additional objects and behavior.
Original LengthSq and RotateVector names now exist on QuaternionD; multiplication matches C++ explicit scalar formulas, but proof and all edge cases remain unverified.
Ported constructor, ClearBoxes, DeleteFromBoxes, InsertInBox, GetInflatedRadius and SetBoxActive; abstract collision methods are a trait and concrete geometry is not ported.
C++ parent-ball-ID then object-ID ordering is implemented, with Bevy Entity lookups substituting C++ pointers.
Key-ordered Box comparator; Bevy entity dereference boundary. Formal equivalence unproven.
Original Ball.cpp comparator branches ported against temporary PartitionBall metadata; full Ball type not yet implemented.
